spec_match.rationale: Two float16 contexts request 'standard' and 'extended', draw identical ramps up to 8x white with color(srgb-linear …), and read back float16 values. Captions show each context's echoed mode.

interactive.rationale: The peak slider redraws both canvases, the dynamic-range-limit select restyles them and reports the computed value, and the readback button fills a float16 vs unorm8 table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the card: the same bitmap values, mode-only difference, and the dynamic-range-limit interplay.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers SDR displays (labelled as manual observation), clipping in the 8-bit view and dynamic-range-limit. The visual HDR difference cannot be measured from a page.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, the explainer's dynamic-range-limit section and the WebGPU mode definitions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless (Playwright), default and with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: every button, select and range exercised, console/pageerror/failed-request clean, 0px overflow. Readback reached 2.443 (sRGB-encoded) at 8x while unorm8 read 255. matchMedia(dynamic-range: high) was false in headless, so no HDR visual could be observed.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts context creation (with the echoed modes in details) and that float readback holds values above 1 when the peak is above 1.

design_system.rationale: Variables only. Canvas internals use CSS color() values, which are the subject of the demo rather than page chrome.

accessibility.rationale: Canvases are role=img with names, labelled range/select with outputs, a status region and a readback table.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The canvases scale by aspect-ratio and the fact grid collapses to one column. 0px overflow at 360 and 1280.

openQuestions.title: Verify the extended success path and the HDR visual on a build with CanvasToneMapping
openQuestions.detail: Chrome 153, the only build available here, reports toneMapping.mode 'standard' even with --enable-blink-features=CanvasToneMapping, so the honoured branch has not run. Re-verify on Chrome 160+/Canary with the flag, ideally on an HDR display: confirm the echo reads 'extended' and that the bottom ramp, sun and highlights exceed SDR white.

openQuestions.title: Capture an HDR-display screenshot or photo
openQuestions.detail: Add evidence from a real HDR panel showing the extended canvas brighter than the standard one, and stepping down under dynamic-range-limit: standard.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls should be at least 44x44 CSS px on touch screens, and components should adapt to their container so nothing overflows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons, selects, inputs and ranges have min-height 44px. Selects inside .field are width:100% after a measured 117px overflow at 360px caused by long option text. Every page was re-measured at 0px overflow at 360x740 and 1280x800.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: drive.js runs: overflow=0 on every page/viewport; responsive-check desktop ok 1/1, mobile ok 1/1

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels. Announce discrete outcomes through polite status/log regions and keep rapidly changing values out of live regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every control is a native button/select/input with a visible label. Outcomes go to role=status / role=log regions. High-frequency readouts (slider positions, meters) use aria-live=off and announce only on change of state.

guidanceConsulted.query: canvas HDR wide gamut color rendering
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: The guide covers the html-in-canvas origin trial and is gated behind an explicit opt-in.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: no origin-trial opt-in was made (npx modern-web-guidance@latest set-allow-origin-trials not run). Canvas content is exposed with role=img plus aria-label and a text status/readback table carrying the same information.

summary: The canonical side-by-side demo: identical HDR bitmaps that differ only in tone-mapping mode, with honest labelling of what a page can and cannot measure.
